p1.title: Open source
p1.text: The code is open under AGPL-3.0-only.

p2.title: Three languages
p2.text: Every text exists in Uzbek, Russian and English.

p3.title: Answers with sources
p3.text: The assistant answers from your notebooks and the school knowledge base; web search is a switch you control.

p4.title: Soft AI limits
p4.text: Administrators set AI limits and can change them at any time.

p5.title: Private security
p5.text: Vulnerabilities are reported privately and acknowledged within 2 business days; MCP access is granted per scope and can be revoked.

pills.title: Ask less, get to it faster

control.title: You stay in control.
control.visualLabel: Example of assistant connector permissions and call log

b1.title: Consent
b1.text: Each assistant gets only the permissions you choose, and the school’s legal consent is enforced on the server.

b2.title: Call log
b2.text: See the calls your assistants made, kept for 90 days. Arguments are redacted and content is never logged.

b3.title: Your data
b3.text: Export your data as a ZIP file or ask for your account to be erased after an administrator’s review.
